title: Elevator World?
content: This may be a spin-off of Mall World and similar MW Variants. This world focuses heavily on elevators. It may take place in a tall building or a skyscraper with heavy emphasis on the elevators. There's frequent travel up and down the elevators. The elevator themselves are strange sometimes. They're sometimes retro or vintage elevators or sometime very "advanced" or futuristic or retro-futuristic. Sometimes you get off on "strange floors" or the layout of the whole building is "strange". Some parts of it seem "normal" but other parts of it a very "strange"
